name: Procurement Clause Differ
one_liner: Diffs enterprise procurement questionnaires against a vendor's previous answers and flags newly added clauses for review.

mechanism.actor: founders of small B2B vendors answering enterprise security questionnaires
mechanism.trigger: a prospect sends a new procurement questionnaire during a sales cycle
steps: Parse the incoming questionnaire into clause-level records keyed by topic and obligation
Match each clause against the vendor's answer library from previous questionnaires
Flag unmatched or changed clauses with the closest previous answer for human review
mechanism.replaces_workaround: Founders keep a spreadsheet of past answers and search it by hand for each new questionnaire

why_now.change: Clause-level document parsing became reliable enough to key obligations without manual templating

descriptor.bottleneck: clause matching against prior answers is manual

falsification.test: Offer a manual clause-diff service to ten vendors currently in procurement cycles
falsification.kill_condition: Fewer than three vendors accept the free manual service
